title: Forge version compare
description: Baseline vs candidate build: speed per turn, per pod and per span, AI timeouts, and whether the games changed.

options.content: Pick **Baseline** and **Candidate** above. `./bench.sh compare` runs both on the same seeds, so they play the same games until an AI decision hits its 5 s cap. **Speedup** = baseline / candidate: green above 1.05, red below 0.95. Trust it only with tens of games per pod; single games vary a lot.

panels.title: Seconds per turn
panels.description: Game wall time divided by turns played, over the whole time range.

panels.title: Speedup per turn
panels.description: Baseline / candidate. Above 1: the candidate is faster.

panels.title: AI speedup
panels.description: Baseline / candidate. Above 1: the candidate is faster.

panels.title: Games played
panels.description: Sample size. A faster build plays more games in the same time.

panels.title: AI timeouts per 1000 decisions
panels.description: Spell choices that hit the 5 s cap and were skipped. Faster engine code should push this toward 0.

panels.title: Avg turns per game
panels.description: Should match when the candidate only changes speed. A big gap means the AI plays differently.

panels.title: Static passes per priority step
panels.description: Full continuous-effect recomputes per priority step. A delta-based engine should lower this.

panels.title: Game timeouts + errors
panels.description: Games stopped by the sim clock (GAME_TIMEOUT) or an exception.

targets.expr: (sum by (forge_pod) (increase(forge_game_duration_seconds_sum{service_version="$baseline",forge_scenario=~"$scenario",forge_pod=~"$pod"}[$__range])) / sum by (forge_pod) (increase(forge_game_turns_sum{service_version="$baseline",forge_scenario=~"$scenario",forge_pod=~"$pod"}[$__range]))) / (sum by (forge_pod) (increase(forge_game_duration_seconds_sum{service_version="$candidate",forge_scenario=~"$scenario",forge_pod=~"$pod"}[$__range])) / sum by (forge_pod) (increase(forge_game_turns_sum{service_version="$candidate",forge_scenario=~"$scenario",forge_pod=~"$pod"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Engine and AI spans (whole time range)
Spans
panels.description: Mean time per call (children included) and calls per priority step. Calls per step should match unless the candidate skips or adds work; a change there with the same games means the engine does less (or more) per action.

targets.expr: (sum by (span_name) (increase(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_sum{service_name="forge-sim",service_version="$baseline",span_name!="AiController.decisionTimeout"}[$__range])) / sum by (span_name) (increase(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_count{service_name="forge-sim",service_version="$baseline",span_name!="AiController.decisionTimeout"}[$__range]))) / (sum by (span_name) (increase(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_sum{service_name="forge-sim",service_version="$candidate",span_name!="AiController.decisionTimeout"}[$__range])) / sum by (span_name) (increase(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_count{service_name="forge-sim",service_version="$candidate",span_name!="AiController.decisionTimeout"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Seconds per turn
panels.description: Over the hour before each point, so it is smooth even though games finish minutes apart.

panels.title: AI timeouts per 1000 decisions
panels.description: Per decision, not per hour: a faster build makes more decisions per hour, so raw counts would rise.

panels.title: Did the games change? (whole time range)
Winners
panels.description: How often each commander won its pod, per build. Same seeds: a speed-only change should give similar shares. Games diverge after an AI timeout, and the faster build plays more games, so expect some drift, not a different story.

targets.expr: round(sum by (forge_pod, forge_outcome) (increase(forge_game_duration_seconds_count{service_version="$baseline",forge_scenario=~"$scenario",forge_pod=~"$pod"}[$__range]))) / ignoring (forge_outcome) group_left sum by (forge_pod) (round(sum by (forge_pod, forge_outcome) (increase(forge_game_duration_seconds_count{service_version="$baseline",forge_scenario=~"$scenario",forge_pod=~"$pod"}[$__range]))))

round(sum by (forge_pod, forge_outcome) (increase(forge_game_duration_seconds_count{service_version="$candidate",forge_scenario=~"$scenario",forge_pod=~"$pod"}[$__range]))) / ignoring (forge_outcome) group_left sum by (forge_pod) (round(sum by (forge_pod, forge_outcome) (increase(forge_game_duration_seconds_count{service_version="$candidate",forge_scenario=~"$scenario",forge_pod=~"$pod"}[$__range]))))
